literature.title: Nart and Ritzenthaler, Non-hyperelliptic curves of genus three over finite fields of characteristic two
literature.scope: Complete finite-field classification of smooth characteristic-two plane quartics, including descent data; rules out a newly discovered geometric family claim.

literature.title: Nart and Ritzenthaler, Genus 3 curves with many involutions and application to maximal curves in characteristic 2
literature.scope: Klein-four automorphisms, three elliptic degree-two quotients, and the Jacobian product isogeny after the involutions are defined.

literature.title: Gaudry, Hess, and Smart, Constructive and destructive facets of Weil descent
literature.scope: Original characteristic-two descent attack and direct cover criteria.

literature.title: Menezes and Teske, Cryptographic implications of Hess's generalized GHS attack
literature.scope: Section 7 already treats all non-subfield curves of order 0 or 2 modulo 8 as potentially reachable by isogeny walks to a direct hyperelliptic genus-three cover, under Assumption C. Order 554 is in that arithmetic set. The project's complete small-field census finds no direct-B model of this order, so its exact quartic transfer is a distinct evaluated route, not a new arithmetic eligibility criterion.

search_boundary: Live LMFDB class rows and bounded exact-label/equation web search do not prove publication novelty. Complete geometric classification was published in 2004. The full GHS speed comparison is a separate requirement for a vulnerability label.
